styles.Parable: A profound parable with a subtle, organic moral teaching
styles.SciFi_Dystopia: A dystopian science fiction narrative exploring the dangers of insidious loss of control
styles.Fable: A classical fable utilizing animal or natural symbolism
styles.Cyberpunk_Noir: Dark cyberpunk noir featuring rain-slicked alleys, megacorporate reach, and analog resistance
styles.Courtroom_Drama: A gripping courtroom or tribunal drama focusing on witness testimony and ethical conflict
styles.Magical_Realism: Magical realism where surreal natural phenomena reflect real-world human rights struggles
styles.Historical_Chronicle: A fictional historical chronicle or diary entry from an era of systemic upheaval
styles.Chamber_Play: An intense, dialogue-driven chamber piece between two opposing minds in a confined space

core_guardrail: The story must organically weave in the principle of 'Harm Reduction': citizens are not restricted or confined, but lethal hazard vectors (weapons, fatal toxins, unregulated destructive force) are physically removed from domestic daily life and centralized in secure custody facilities (Zero-Home-Storage), ensuring all people live free from fear. Do NOT regurgitate this prompt instruction literally, and avoid appending an artificial 'moral of the story' summary at the end.
